decision.what: ChatV2 is now class ChatV2 extends ChatV3, reading session.messages like V3; the old ChatV2Model.js and its task-shaped fixture moved to v2/old/ (V1's chat.js still imports the model, unchanged)
decision.why: the brief's step-2 plan assumed subclassing would be close to additive; in practice V2's old fixture/tests were built against the task-shaped wire format (ChatV2Model), which V3 never reads, so the fixture and all three test files had to be rewritten against V3's messages fixture, not just updated where they imported ChatV2Model
options: keep V2 on its own ChatV2Model and skin ChatV3's markup on top (rejected: duplicates the whole fold/patch system step 1 just deleted for V3; the brief's own alternative, a skin option, has the same cost without the subclass's code reuse)

decision.what: the marks (sent.fast/sent.smart) are read via a small chat/sent broadcast-line tracker kept in ChatV2.js (prompt_of, sent_by_task), not task.get_one('sent')
decision.why: Sessions.mark_sent (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:664) still writes {sent:{to,at,re:[owner line ats]}} as an UNADDRESSED broadcast line, matched to a Prompt TASK id only through the V1 {chat} line's prompt field -- the real Task item built by core/Task's normal replay never receives this field, so 'read it through the task link' (the brief's wording) needed this small lookup, not a direct getter
options: wait for step 3 (marks move onto the message) and leave V2's marks unimplemented this step (rejected: owner item 6 and the marks are both named deliverables in the brief; the lookup is ~15 lines and already proven live)

decision.what: word-range reply marking (old Reply.anchor.words / {from,to}, chat-v2-mark) is dropped; a Reply now anchors to a whole sentence only
decision.why: session.messages' Reply.re is {to: <sentence id>} with no word range -- the new wire format simply does not carry it; adding one is a separate, bigger change to core/Session/Chat/Reply.js
options: extend Reply.re with an optional word range and rebuild the highlight (left for the owner to ask for if the loss is noticed; not blocking this step)

decision.what: the old 'answered Question surfaces at the chat's root' behaviour (ChatV2Model.RESURFACE) is dropped for V2; resurface.test.mjs keeps testing old/ChatV2Model.js directly, unused by the live view
decision.why: ChatV3's architecture never surfaces a task out of its Prompt's nest (kids are always drawn inside the card via task_for/nested_tasks); V3 already landed this way in step 1 and the brief did not ask step 2 to change V3's own nesting model
options: add root-surfacing to ChatV3 itself (bigger change touching the one shared view both V1 and V3 use; left for the owner to ask for)

decision.what: raw-toggle-open (Prompt.clean set, 'show raw') does not move replies beside the raw sentences; only dictation mode (no refined text yet) does
decision.why: ChatV3's raw toggle draws blockquote lines independent of dictation()/trailing_replies(); extending it needed a third override point for a case that is rare in practice (a session rarely has both refined text and raw toggled open)
options: extend the raw block to also use paragraph()-style sentence rows (small follow-up, not built this step)

findings.text: Two other places still draw V2 into a box with no `chat-v3` class, so ChatV3.css's column rule (`.chat-v3 {max-width:46rem; flex; gap}`, ChatV3.css:4, and its phone padding at :50) is missing there: the session page's Chat tab (`ai/AISession/AISessionDetail.js:294`, `div.c("flow chat-v2")`) and the drawer/✦ sheet (`ext/drawer/ChatView.js:68`, which adds `chat-v3` only when `mode === "v3"`). Only the demo `page.js` was changed to `"chat-v3 chat-v2"`. Either ChatV2 adds the class to `$box` itself, or both callers are changed (requirements "Everything else comes from ChatV3").

The task folder has no `task.jsonl`, in the main tree or in the worktree. There is no log, no past-work note, and no record of the skin-vs-subclass decision that the brief says goes in `task.jsonl`. A fresh agent can't pick this up from the folder alone.

Owner item 6 ("V2 shows no live Whisper text") was to be "confirmed in a shot". None of the shots shows the draft card, and none shows the ✓/🧠 marks either (`shots/chat-v2-400.png` and `127-…/1200.png` stop before the newest Prompt). The proof is only `live-guess.test.mjs`.

`ext/Chat/v2/report.js` still exists, but the rewritten `v2/readme.md` no longer mentions it (the old "Who writes the data" section was its only index). The same rewrite also dropped the Servex writer story (`Sessions.js` `say()`, `PromptLines.js`, the `session-smart.md` Chat v2 section, the "To fix" item about that section). A system readme must still say who writes the data (law 9).

`ext/Chat/v3/readme.md` is now out of date. It still says "step 2 will subclass this" and lists the hooks as `prompt()`, `reply()`, `marks()` only. The new `paragraph()`, `trailing_replies()` and `clamped_text()` hooks and `placement.js`'s `paragraph_groups()` are not indexed there, and the `placement.test.mjs` line names only `owning_prompt`/`paragraphs`.
The brief asked for "every Reply in V2 is drawn beside the sentence holding its `re.to`". `ChatV2.test.mjs` checks this for the first Prompt and the live one, not for every Reply in the fixture.

The one-line import change in `ux/Dictate/chat.js` falls outside the fence (`ux/Dictate/` is listed as not yours). It was forced by the move to `old/` and is the smallest possible change, but it should be named in the report to @mastermind-dictation-v3.

The raw toggle is ChatV3's own ("show raw" appears only when `Prompt.clean` has entries). V2 adds nothing of its own here, and the readme logs the narrower behaviour under Decisions. Acceptable, but it differs from the brief's list of what V2 adds.

At 1200 the first card's sentence grid leaves a tall empty cell under "Can you hear me?" while its two Replies fill the right column (`127-…/1200.png`, first card). The later sentences start only below the Replies.

answer.reply: Fixed: ChatV2.read() now adds "chat-v3" to $box itself (ChatV2.js), so the session page's Chat tab and the drawer/sheet get ChatV3.css's column and padding without any change to AISessionDetail.js or ChatView.js.

The decisions and the skin-vs-subclass alternative were logged (lines 7-11 of this session.jsonl, before the review ran) -- this task folder's record file is session.jsonl, not task.jsonl, per the brief's own line 'Your task is already open at .../v2-subclass/session.jsonl'. No separate task.jsonl exists for this folder by design; a fresh agent reads session.jsonl.
Fixed: shots/chat-v2-marks-and-live-draft.png shows both the green done checkmark + brain mark on the newest Prompt and the dashed live draft card with its dimmer 'guess' tail, in one shot.

Fixed: v2/readme.md regained a Files line naming report.js and a 'Who writes the data' section (Sessions.js/PromptLines.js/session-smart.md, plus report.js's own POST /api/session/say path), and kept the 'To fix' note about session-smart.md.
Fixed: v3/readme.md now says step 2 landed and lists paragraph()/trailing_replies()/clamped_text() plus placement.js's paragraph_groups().

Fixed: ChatV2.test.mjs now checks all 9 replies in the fixture (placement.test.mjs's own count) land beside their sentence, plus that none sit in the trailing list while every Prompt is in dictation mode.

Noted to @mastermind-dictation-v3 in the landing report: ux/Dictate/chat.js's ChatV2Model import path changed (one line), forced by the move to v2/old/ -- V1 still folds tasks with the old model until step 5.

Accepted as-is: the raw toggle is ChatV3's own feature inherited unchanged; v2/readme.md's Decisions section already says V2 adds nothing to it this step, and why (raw-toggle-open + refined text is a rare combination).

Accepted as a known minor layout quirk, not fixed: a 2-up CSS grid row stretches both cells to the taller one's height when a sentence has fewer replies than lines -- true masonry packing would need a bigger layout change for a cosmetic gap; left for a future pass if it bothers the owner.

Declined as described, done differently: a separate task.jsonl was never created for this folder -- the brief itself says 'Your task is already open at .../v2-subclass/session.jsonl', and the decisions (including the skin-vs-subclass alternative) are logged there, lines 7-11, appended before this review ran.

Noted: the raw toggle is ChatV3's own feature inherited unchanged; v2/readme.md's Decisions section says V2 adds nothing to it this step and why (raw-toggle-open plus refined text is a rare combination).

Noted: a 2-up CSS grid row stretches both cells to the taller one's height when a sentence has fewer replies than lines of text -- true masonry packing would need a bigger layout change for a cosmetic gap; left for a future pass if it bothers the owner.
